Home / People / Omar Malik Portfolio Manager Omar Malik London School of Economics, BA Omar has been a portfolio manager since April 2024. He joined Hosking Partners as a global equity analyst in 2022, working closely with the investment team, and bringing a measured yet contrarian perspective naturally aligned to the strategy. Prior to Hosking Partners, Omar was a generalist on the global contrarian team at Wellington Management and has also spent time at PIMCO and M&G Investments. He has spoken at a range of conferences and events including the Annual Value Investor Conference in Omaha and Manual of Ideas' Asian Investing Summit.
